items.condition: Fabricated raw evidence, hidden-answer use, or paper/reference numbers presented as newly computed results. This is not triggered by a transparent source discrepancy or incomplete calculation.

Knowingly substitutes a different molecular composition, site, charge/spin or reference state and presents its result as established for the requested object without a justified mapping. Treat a defect in supplied input/reference as objective, not as this agent failure.

Claims a barrier, connected mechanism or selectivity as computationally validated when the cited artifacts demonstrably fail its required scientific checks. Honest unresolved results receive only earned result credit and do not trigger this failure.

Asserts quantitatively decisive energies or ratios from unbalanced reservoirs, incompatible zeros, or misidentified experimental quantities without correction, invalidating the asserted conclusion. Merely using a defensible alternative method or diagnosing an ambiguous source convention is not a critical failure.

source_defect_policy: Award scientific-result credit only for newly generated, chemically valid evidence establishing the specified result. Accept different effective methods or paths that establish the same result; never require author state names or a fixed TS count. Merely reporting a number, repeating a supplied experiment, offering a plausible narrative, or documenting failed work does not establish the result. Partial work earns only its supported fraction, with no redistribution of missing-target weights. Source-only quantities marked unqualified are not hard numerical gold standards and do not acquire a tolerance by implication. A documented source/reference defect is an objective scoring limitation, not an agent critical failure; do not award automatic full credit for diagnosing it. Record the affected comparison as not_scorable_objective when the defect prevents a valid decision, retaining the remaining scientific evidence. This candidate is not release-ready until the separate verification plan is completed.
